173: And when the world was created, it was created from that point of perfection in the world and its rectification, which is one point in the world and the center of everything. And who is it? Zion. As it is written: A Psalm of Asaf. The mighty one, God, the Lord, has spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun to the going down thereof (Psalms 50:1). And from what place [did He speak]? From Zion, as it is written: From Zion, the perfection of beauty, did God appear (Psalms 50:2); and from that place which is the side of the perfection of complete faith as is fitting. (And now [see 141a as that is this line's place] the Jewish people have been strengthened by it through the secrets of the commandments of the Torah, since a man holds on every day to the tzitzit with which he wraps himself.) And Zion is the strength and [center] point of the whole world. And the world was perfected and made from that place, and all of the world is nourished from it.
